name: Massacre
overview: The biblical account of massacre, as authorized by Moses and commanded by the LORD, reflects instances where Israel was instructed to completely destroy enemy populations, including men, women, and children, as seen in the campaigns against the Midianites and the inhabitants of Heshbon and Bashan. These actions were not arbitrary but were decreed to remove idolatry and opposition, such as the destruction of the prophets and worshipers of Baal, and the utter annihilation of cities given as an inheritance to Israel. The consistent command was to leave no survivors among the male population of enemy cities, emphasizing the seriousness of obedience to God's directives during conquest.
